ravi: quick flag from the orion-lite int8 bring-up. on the ja->en dev slice we saw odd token merges when U+2007 (figure space) is placed between CJK and latin. small but reproducible BLEU hit (~0.7).

hana: can you paste a repro? want to see if tokenization or postproc is at fault.

ravi: repro below. fp16 preserves the figure-space, int8 run shows joining. both pre-tokenize outputs from our tokenizer binary are identical.

```
# repro (UTF-8 aware terminal)
echo -n "\u65e5\u672c\u2007hello" | ./infer --model orion-lite --quant int8 --input -
# output-int8: \u65e5\u672chello
# output-fp16: \u65e5\u672c\u2007hello
```

leo: i dug into the canary traces. the int8 canary runs `postprocess:v0.9-compat` sidecar which has a legacy normalization that treats figure space as ignorable and collapses it. the fp16 canary uses `postprocess:main`.

hana: so again this is a postprocess image mismatch. pattern emerges: quant canaries pinned to older postproc images that collapse unusual spaces.

ravi: i bypassed the postproc step locally (joined tokens naively) and the figure space was preserved and BLEU returned to baseline. confirms postproc.

anya: action items: (1) add unit tests to postproc to preserve U+2007 when adjacent to wide characters; (2) patch orion-lite int8 manifest to point to postprocess:main for now; (3) add figure-space, narrow/nobreak/zwsp samples to the multilingual dev bundle and the quant smoke matrix.

leo: opened PR #732 on postproc with a preserving change + tests. CI running.

eng-ci-bot: [CI] postproc PR #732 started  running 11 tests

hana: also proposing a manifest lint in infra that fails bring-ups when postproc image tag < main or missing the preserve_spaces flag. prevents pin drift.

ravi: re-ran the int8 eval after swapping to postprocess:main  BLEU delta drops to 0.03. rendering and token boundaries good.

eng-ci-bot: [CI] postproc PR #732 passed  11 tests :white_check_mark:

anya: adding a short note to the onboarding doc about postproc pins and whitespace-sensitive locales. also adding an integration check for figure/thin/nb/zw spaces to the locale smoke suite.

leo: thanks team. marking resolved; we'll keep an eye on other odd-spacing chars (figure space was new to me). ping if you see FIGURE SPACE or other unusual unicode in customer logs. :eyes:
